list.name: Unexplained deviation
Hypotension alert

targets.query:
from(bucket: "twin") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vitals" and r.case == "${case}" and r._field == "map")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> set(key: "_field", value: "MAP measured")

from(bucket: "twin") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "forecast" and r.case == "${case}" and r._field == "map_1min" and r.horizon == "300")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> set(key: "_field", value: "1-min MAP forecast 5 min ago")

from(bucket: "twin") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vitals" and r.case == "${case}" and r._field == "nibp_map")

panels.title: Suggested targets and their expected effect in 5 min (AnestheSIM)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "twin") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "suggestion" and r.case == "${case}" and (r._field == "setting_decrease" or r._field == "setting_increase" or r._field =~ /^effect_.*\.(bis|map)@300$/))
  |> last() |> group() |> pivot(rowKey: ["drug"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_measurement", "case"])

panels.title: Forecast fidelity so far: RMSE, twin vs persistence

targets.query:
from(bucket: "twin") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "forecast_fidelity" and r.case == "${case}")
  |> last() |> group() |> pivot(rowKey: ["signal", "horizon"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_measurement", "case"])

panels.title: Expert fidelity over the case (Ce vs pump; BIS, MAP vs measured)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "twin") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fidelity" and r.case == "${case}" and r.window == "case")
  |> last() |> group() |> pivot(rowKey: ["expert", "signal"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_measurement", "case"])
